        "All 288 owned diff lines across three paths were read. Each authorization request stores a new state value generated from a requested 32 bytes and sends it in the URL. The PKCE verifier separately requests 64 bytes. onAuthorizationReceived copies expectedState, clears the field, then rejects a mismatch only when that saved expected state is truthy. Code exchange follows the check. This is exact conditional state consumption, not proof that every unsolicited/repeated callback is rejected or that all attack cases are prevented.",
        "The full own review requests explicit 32 at the caller, typed JSDoc, the length/encoding regex, a state-check comment, telemetry and a visible readonly mock state field. Actual original/accepted code adopts those changes despite one Not Done label. Alternative digest APIs and speculative underlying implementation equivalence were discussion. The security group was removed; no separate security approval is fabricated. The helper return doc retains the endcoding typo; it could use plain accurate wording without changing its scope.",
        "The new external negative task asserts a 43-character URL-safe state shape, NS_ERROR_ABORT, no refresh/access token, no stored login and state-mismatch telemetry. OAuth2Module's rejection adapter explains the abort result although the lower state check supplies NS_ERROR_FAILURE. Existing success scenarios echo the request state through the mock utility; missing-state, repeated-callback, cancellation and every embedded/custom-scheme path are not all new regression cases. Accepted test later uses countLoginsAsync, expectSuccess:false and external-localhost telemetry; those are later phases.",
